The PDF for non-zero counts, \(\log_{10}\) transformed

d_nz_counts_log.Rd

The PDF for non-zero counts, \(\log_{10}\) transformed

Usage

d_nz_counts_log(hatxi, xi, bvm = 13, pars = par_nb())

Arguments

hatxi

\(\log_{10}\) parasite counts

xi

\(\log_{10}\) parasite densities

bvm

blood volume as \(\log_{10}\) red blood cells

pars

parameters that define a detection function

Value

binary detection result
